newsitem.title: USA: D&P puts McDonnell Douglas on rating watch-up.
newsitem.headline: D&P puts McDonnell Douglas on rating watch-up.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it had put the debt of McDonnell Douglas Corp on rating watch-up, reflecting the company's definitive agreement to merge with Boeing Co.
McDonnell's senior unsecured debt is currently rated single-A-minus.
D&P said its action includes McDonnell Douglas Finance Corp's senior debt, rated single-A-minus, and its subordinated debt, rated triple-B-plus.
The merger with Boeing will create the largest company in the aerospace industry with indicated 1997 sales of more than $48 billion, D&P said.
The financial condition is strong, with combined debt-to-invested capital in the mid-30 percent range, it said.
McDonnell Douglas had about $3 billion of debt outstanding at September 30, including about $1.8 billion of financial services debt.
